page_title: HEI 0-0 DOR | Heidenheim v Dortmund 02/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A free kick into the box, taken by Florian Pick (Heidenheim), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+5' It's a free kick to Heidenheim in a dangerous position.
90+5' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+5' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+4' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Heidenheim earn a corner.
90+1' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' It will be a substitution. Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) is ready to enter the pitch as Tim Kleindienst walks off.
89' Good defending. Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) tries to find Donyell Malen inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
88' The attendance is 15000.
86' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
86' Ole Pohlmann (Dortmund) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

86' Kevin Muller leaps like a salmon to deny Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. Corner kick. Dortmund will have an opportunity.
83' Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
81' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Dortmund.
80' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
80' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Kevin Muller.
78' Florian Pick bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
78' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

77' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Kevin Muller who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund) is replacing Youssoufa Moukoko.
74' Donyell Malen races towards the box before laying off to Ole Pohlmann (Dortmund), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
73' Florian Pick (Heidenheim) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

72' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
70' Frank Schmidt is forced to make a change. Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Florian Pick.
70' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
69' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:8. 0:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
68' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
64' Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) tries to find Tim Kleindienst, but he puts too much power on the pass.
61' The substitution has been made. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) has replaced Marvin Pieringer.
61' Here is a change. Eren Dinkci is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim).
61' It is time for a substitution. Marnon Busch (Heidenheim) is on for Omar Haktab Traore.
60' The corner is swung in but Dortmund can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Ole Pohlmann (Dortmund) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jamie Bynoe-Gittens.
59' Edin Terzic decides to make a substitution. Thomas Meunier will be replaced by Marius Wolf (Dortmund).
59' It's time for a substitution. Emre Can (Dortmund) comes on in place of Salih Ozcan.
58' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

56' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the right side of the goal. His effort is blocked by Kevin Muller with a brilliant diving save!
55' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
53' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
49' Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
49' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
49' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Dortmund will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
48' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
41' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Niclas Fullkrug. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
40' Dortmund take a short corner kick.

40' That didn't go as planned! Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Kevin Muller, who easily kept it out. Dortmund force a corner. They send men into the box.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Dortmund.

39' A lofted cross from Thomas Meunier (Dortmund) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Dortmund are awarded a corner kick.
37' Jonas Fohrenbach (Heidenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
37' The corner from Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) is intercepted by the defence.

36' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Heidenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
33' The total number of attempts is 5:2. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:0.
30' The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post.
30' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
30' The ball is cleared after Youssoufa Moukoko (Dortmund) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Dortmund are going to take it.
28' The Dortmund players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Bastian Dankert signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
27' The goal for Dortmund is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
26' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) is released by Youssoufa Moukoko, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
24' What a great touch by Eren Dinkci (Heidenheim) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
24' Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' The flag is raised and Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) is offside again, not for the first time today.
18' What a chance that is! Jonas Fohrenbach swings the ball into the box, and Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the left post.
18' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
16' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
14' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
14' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick.
12' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
9' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) offside.
8' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
7' The referee blows his whistle after Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
5' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
5' Donyell Malen (Dortmund) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Dortmund. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

The players are on the pitch and Dortmund will have the kick-off.
